'''Uumlourti''' were slimy protoplasmic strips used as delicious food by [[Gand/Legends|Gand]]. However, it was an acquired taste, and uumlourti were even deadly poison to some species on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gand (planet)/Legends|Gand]].
